headline: Huang Agrees to Testify Before Congress Soon, GOP Lawmaker Says
author: Erik Wasson

paragraphs.text: Thu, November 12, 2026 at 10:13 AM CST 1 min read

(Bloomberg) -- Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang, who was ousted from his post after reports of an affair with a woman suspected of spying for China, has agreed to testify before Congress, a key Republican said Thursday.
Huang agreed to the testimony on Wednesday night after several top lawmakers threatened to subpoena him, House Foreign Affairs Chairman Brian Mast told reporters at the US Capitol.

The embattled Nvidia founder is expected to testify under oath before the Thanksgiving holiday later this month. It appears the testimony will be behind closed doors, but Mast said he expects it to be on video and transcribed.

"Jensen and I have been very at odds as some of you already know on export controls, but Nvidia is a very important company to the United States of America," Mast said. "I don't want to see anything hurt in Nvidia, but he has some very serious questions to answer."
Mast's committee, along with the House's China and Intelligence panels, will participate.
